note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-4 Nexter-Group sales brochure for the VBCI 8x8 armoured vehicle family (reference NEX_141_2VOL_VBCI_EN_01A, edition 01/2022). It holds the VBCI infantry fighting vehicle as a wheeled entry. The brochure is a maker sales document, so every value is grade claimed. It publishes identity, the empty weight, the payload, the chassis length, width and height as upper bounds, the usable interior volume, the carrying capacity, the diesel engine rating of 600 HP, the automatic gearbox with seven forward and two reverse ratios, the 8-wheel drive running gear, the central tyre inflation system, the run-flat device, the road speed and range, the step, trench and fording figures, the protection levels and the armament options. It publishes no ground clearance, no tyre size code or tyre width or tyre diameter, no net power with a stated basis and no exact overall dimension, because the three chassis dimensions are stated only as upper bounds, so the entry is not runtime-ready. The three dimension values are recorded as the published upper bound and the state names the bound; they are not presented as exact measurements. The empty weight is published in tons. The maker is named in the brochure footer as Nexter Systems.
